author: Swinhoe, 1873
habitat: 갈대밭, 작은 물웅덩이, 풀이 우거진 습지
summary: 갈대밭, 작은 물웅덩이, 풀이 무성한 습지에 사는 드문 여름철새로, 서남해안에 서식한다. 물고기, 개구리, 곤충 따위를 주로 잡아먹는다. 물가의 갈대 줄기 위나 풀이 우거진 땅 위에 풀잎과 줄기로 둥지를 짓고 알 5~6개를 낳는다. 세계적으로는 동아시아에 분포한다.

points.en: creamy-white chin and sides of throat
deep reddish-chestnut ear coverts, neck sides and hindneck
single dark brown stripe from chin to breast
dark chestnut from forehead to scapulars (male)
small round white spots on back and scapulars (female)

sexes.female: 이마와 머리꼭대기는 수컷과 같으나, 어두운 밤색 등과 어깨에 작고 둥근 흰 점이 흩어져 있다.

art.subject: Von Schrenck's Bittern (Ixobrychus eurhythmus), adult male: dark chestnut from forehead to scapulars, pale chestnut-brown rump, deep reddish-chestnut ear coverts and neck sides, creamy-white chin and throat sides, a single dark brown stripe from chin to breast, buff foreneck, breast and belly, brownish breast sides and flanks
art.pose: standing motionless among reeds at the water's edge, side view
art.scene: Korean summer wetland near the southwest coast: reedbed and small pools with dense grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing: dark chestnut upperparts, reddish-chestnut neck, single dark stripe down the buff underparts
adult female, side view standing: dark chestnut back and scapulars scattered with small round white spots
